create_LTX2HalveResolutionStage: create an LTX2HalveResolutionStage pipeline stage to halve batch height and width for low-res generation
create_LTX2LoRASwitchStage: create an LTX2LoRASwitchStage pipeline stage to switch LoRA configuration between two-stage phases
create_LTX2UpsampleStage: create an LTX2UpsampleStage pipeline stage to upsample stage-1 video latents and prepare stage-2 inputs
run_LTX2UpsampleStage_forward: run the LTX2UpsampleStage forward method to upsample video latents, restore resolution, and pack latents for stage 2
test_LTX2HalveResolutionStage_validation: test LTX2HalveResolutionStage validates that resolution is divisible by the required alignment factor
